purpose: Resolve the Scan 008 narrow watch by testing the hard Mobilization question: whether real local demand self-propels into a routable channel and leaves non-bypassable value for Rooter after local/regional providers exist.

decisive_result.reason: Current local evidence proves reverse-engineering demand and real paid projects, but the strongest direct provider evidence also shows that natural online acquisition was weak and growth required targeted industrial-park connection/visits. Current local/regional providers already offer the technical service, large repeat buyers can internalize scanners, and no public evidence binds a recurring non-founder demand pump or non-bypassable orchestration premium. The service can be real while the Rooter control-plane thesis fails.

evidence: 徐州多帮三维科技 reports surveying nearly ten local manufacturing enterprises before launch and finding local reverse-engineering demand with difficulty finding providers.

The same company reports real customer work in large engineering-machinery deformation-repair scanning/modeling, Mercedes-AMG body-part scanning/modeling/3D-print trials, and a 17m large-component project.
demand_truth.public_procurement_signal: Targeted searches did not produce a clean named Xuzhou manufacturing buyer purchasing on-site industrial reverse-engineering as a recurring service; visible public demand was mainly supplier-reported projects or equipment acquisition.

direct_counterevidence: 徐州多帮三维科技 says it initially used online technical-service platforms intensively but generated only about RMB 7000 over six months, with revenue largely consumed by acquisition.
The founder explicitly concluded the online model did not fit the current stage.
The company then shifted toward local industry connections, industrial-park targeted visits and social-content outreach.
self_propulsion.conclusion: Demand does not currently appear to enter a scalable neutral routing layer by itself. Provider-led market development remains material.

local: 徐州多帮三维科技 provides local scanning/modeling and recruits flexible reverse-engineering designers.
徐州华顺测控 provides 3D scanning, reverse engineering, material analysis, simulation and related on-site industrial services.
regional: 南京宁瑞 markets on-site scanning/reverse engineering for large machinery, including no-disassembly/no-drawing cases and scan-to-CAD delivery.
internalization: 徐州徐工港口机械 publicly procured a 3D scanner in 2026, showing a repeat/high-volume user can internalize the capability.

rooter_fit_recheck.task_unit: one on-site industrial-object scan plus bounded reverse-model deliverable
rooter_fit_recheck.conclusion: Task mechanics are attractive but the commercial control plane is not self-propelled. Rooter would inherit customer discovery/sales work rather than merely routing an existing flow.

kill_conditions_hit: Customer acquisition appears to require targeted factory/industrial-park outreach rather than recurring neutral inbound.
Current local and regional providers already directly sell the technical service.
Large repeat buyers can internalize scanning capability.
No public named buyer event establishes a fragmented acquisition path that a neutral routing layer uniquely fixes.
High buyer-provider bypass risk remains after first successful project.
No recurring acceptance/availability layer was shown to command a separate orchestration premium.

human_probe.reason: The hard Mobilization gate already fails on direct self-propulsion evidence. Calling factories now would be trying to discover/construct a demand pump after the strongest observed provider says targeted local selling is required.

reopen_condition: New direct evidence shows a recurring non-founder inbound channel (repair/MRO/procurement/search/partner workflow) producing on-site reverse-engineering tasks before provider sales outreach.
At least two providers compete for the same standardized task unit and availability/QA/acceptance remains fragmented.
A named buyer shows measurable acquisition/coordination cost after current direct providers and internalization options are considered.
Rooter can retain value through routing/QA/availability rather than first-introduction commission.

portfolio_effect.next_action: Continue fresh scanning under locked Mobilization doctrine. Start from observed bilateral action and existing workaround cost; do not begin from service categories that require founder/provider market education.
